### Uprooted tree

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

### Scatter Stones

### Bat Aside the Missile

*A broad hand or haft meets the incoming missile with the ease of brushing a branch aside.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Scatter stones across the approach and shove foes toward the rough ground. Throw an available rock at anyone refusing to close.

**Encounter and conversation:** Its livestock keep wandering into farms; an honest boundary settlement is possible before pride becomes violence.

**Habitat:** Highland; quarry; remote stronghold · **Communication:** Common and Giant

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-hill-giant


**Category:** Giant · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 31

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Uprooted tree | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Push 1. | 10 physical damage. Push 3. |
| Thrown stone | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 4/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.596, O=6.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [Bat Aside the Missile](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/bat-aside-the-missile.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [scatter stones](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/scatter-stones.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Bat Aside the Missile

*A broad hand or haft meets the incoming missile with the ease of brushing a branch aside.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-bat-aside-the-missile

**Action:** Reaction

Before one physical ranged attack from a visible attacker against this creature is rolled, impose 1 Bane on that attack. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to its defense instead. No protection against area attacks; no missile is returned and the attack still resolves.
